basics.name: Eric Aguayo
basics.headline: Software Development Engineer | Transitioning to Agentic Ops Engineer
basics.summary: Software Development Engineer with 15+ years of software engineering excellence, now transitioning into Agentic Ops Engineering at the intersection of AI, Data Pipelines, and Cloud Infrastructure. Expert in orchestrating Agents in the SDLC, building custom harnesses with various APIs (including Antigravity SDK), designing Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and engineering production-grade RAG pipelines. Extensive experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab Pipelines, and AI-native DevOps strategies using Terraform and EKS. Proficient in Cloudflare Serverless (Workers, D1, R2, Vectorize, AI Gateway, AI Search) and absolute privacy via Zero Trust, Cloudflare One (WARP), and Tunnels. Deeply experienced with AWS ecosystems (Bedrock, Lambda, EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, S3) and AI-assisted development (MCP, Cursor) to accelerate data platforms and model deployments.

experience.position: DataOps & MLOps Engineer | Lead AI Architect
experience.summary:
Architecting DataOps/MLOps pipelines, serverless architectures, and autonomous agentic systems in the SDLC.

  • Integrated Agents into the SDLC and built custom harnesses using various APIs, including the Antigravity SDK.
  • Engineered advanced RAG pipelines and Agentic interfaces using Cloudflare Serverless (Workers, D1, R2, Vectorize, AI Gateway, AI Search), with secure internal connections via Cloudflare One (WARP) and Tunnels under Zero Trust.
  • Automated DataOps/MLOps workflows using GitHub Actions and GitLab Pipelines, orchestrating deployments across AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, S3).
  • Mastered MCP workflows to co-author complex infrastructure decisions and automation scripts with LLMs.

experience.position: Senior AI Software Engineer & Agentic Systems Consultant
experience.summary:
Architecting AI-native solutions and autonomous agentic systems for clients and startups.

  • Engineered RAG pipelines and Agentic RAG Interfaces for Paftesting/Velir CMS-migration consultancy, improving LLM response accuracy and reducing hallucination rates through ground-truth evaluation frameworks.
  • Conducted LLM Hallucination Audits for client AI integrations, establishing structured evaluation protocols and flagging schema gaps impacting answer-engine trustworthiness.
  • Implemented Schema.org structured data and JSON-LD markup across multiple client properties, optimizing entity authority and brand discoverability for Generative Engines (AEO/GEO).
  • Architected meli.run: Athlete Profile & Blog Platform using React/Next.js, Decap CMS, and GitHub Actions CI/CD with structured data for AI-engine indexability.

Delivered high-performance full-stack solutions and scalable infrastructure for top-tier global media brands, bridging the gap between frontend excellence and backend robustness.

  • bleacherreport.com – Spearheaded full-stack engineering and analytics data library integration for a 50M+ MAU sports platform, optimizing frontend delivery through E2E-tested features and cross-team coordination on library integrations.
  • nypost.com (AdTech) – Engineered specialized bid-optimization libraries and real-time bidding services, driving the integration, consolidation and optimization of custom and first-party libraries alongside identity-resolution services like LiveRamp, with privacy by design.
  • la.sonychannel.com – Led the architectural migration of legacy Drupal systems to a modern, decoupled full-stack architecture with Schema.org entity optimization.
  • Enterprise Integration – Orchestrated complex full-stack deployments including SSO/Identity platforms (LoginRadius) and serverless backend logic (AWS Lambda) for high-traffic utilities like nspower.ca.

Delivered full-stack Drupal platforms for government, health, and NGO clients with emphasis on structured data and AI-engine-friendly architecture.

  • wsscwater.com – Architected and launched a responsive Drupal platform serving 1M+ users with complex data migration; implemented Schema.org markup improving knowledge-graph entity coverage.
  • lmi.org – Refactored tightly coupled frontend into a decoupled, maintainable architecture, improving page performance and data crawlability for AI engines.
  • hfsa.org – Engineered events content system with JSON-LD structured data, improving event entity discoverability in answer engines.
  • inee.org – Orchestrated multilingual content search via Apache Solr, enabling structured content retrieval across 5 languages.

Architected and led enterprise platforms for US and LATAM clients, pioneering Knowledge Graph and entity optimization strategies alongside agentic editorial workflows.

  • Engineered Agentic RAG Interfaces for content-discovery workflows, integrating AI-assisted editorial pipelines that reduced content production time by 25%.
  • Implemented Schema.org optimization initiatives across 15+ client properties, establishing entity authority frameworks that improved generative engine citation rates.
  • usfq.edu.ec – Orchestrated Digital Marketing web development team; redesigned institutional platform in Drupal with high-availability infrastructure and Schema.org entity graphs for institutional authority.
  • help.blackboard.com – Architected scalable Drupal migration with a semi-autonomous multilingual translation workflow, optimizing structured content for AI-engine indexability across 10+ languages.
